WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
)
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id brand_id, item.i_brand brand, sum(ss_sales_price) sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN filtered_store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item ON ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
